I began my relationship with Titan Pro 500 around October 2019 through a guy named Jordan James. But later I got in touch with Mary Addison, who would look after me.  Titan Pro 500 included the setup of a TP500 and the connected MT4 trader platform. I transferred a small amount of money to give things a go. I also got on touch with their Compliance department and received some documentation that gave me more confidence. After a few expected market fluctuations, my capital grew.
